Intranasal administration
A procedure in which medicine either in liquid or powder form is administered through the nose.

Management of diseases of nose
Treatment of diseases related to the nose and paranasal regions.

ITA-5.65.20 nāsārbudaḥ नासार्बुदः
Nasal tumour
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a circular swelling over the muscles; fixed circular swelling; mild pain; large in size; broad-based; slow growing; nonsuppurating; obstructing the nasal pathway.

ITA-5.65.21 nāsārśaḥ नासार्शः
Nasal polyp
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: cold catarrh; excessive sneezing; difficulty in breathing; pus discharge from nose; nasal twang in speech; headache.

ITA-5.65.12 nāsāśoṣaḥ नासाशोषः
Excessive dryness of nasal mucosa
A disorder characterized by excessive dryness of the nose; inspiration and expiration with difficulty; feeling as if nose obstructed with śuka.

ITA-9.5.64 nāsāsandhānavidhiḥ नासासन्धानविधिः
Rhinoplasty
